faq.title: Frequently asked questions.

faq.a1: Consultation is free. Deploy in 7 days, no hidden fees.
faq.a2: Standard deployment in 7 days, account activation in just 5 minutes.
faq.a3: ISO 27001 and PCI-DSS Level 1 certified, end-to-end encryption, GDPR compliant.
faq.a4: RESTful API, webhooks, SDKs for 8 languages. Integrate in 5 minutes.
faq.a5: Multilingual team 24/7, SLA response under 15 minutes via chat, email and hotline.
faq.a6: Cancel anytime, no penalties. Your data is fully exported before closing.
